text:
You need someone who can collect, transform, and analyze raw tennis data, then turn it into reliable visuals, dashboards, and advanced insights for players and coaches.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in Python-based data science and machine learning. My toolkit includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I’m comfortable working in analytical, detail-oriented environments where data quality, clarity, and reproducibility matter.

One project that’s relevant here is the Support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues and served it through FastAPI, with nightly retraining handled by a Celery worker on Redis. The model reached a macro-F1 of 0.88 compared with 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and it reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That project required careful data preparation, model evaluation, and building something dependable enough to support real operational decisions.

For your tennis analytics team, I’d apply the same discipline to data collection, transformation, enrichment, and analytical workflows. I’m especially interested in work where the output must be understandable and useful to non-technical stakeholders, because the value of analytics is highest when it can be acted on quickly and confidently. I also appreciate remote collaboration across time zones and the need to work cleanly with other analysts and engineers.

I’d be excited to help build high-quality analytical outputs for professional tennis. Are you mainly looking for someone to focus first on data cleaning and transformation, or on building the dashboards and visual tools you already have in mind?
